method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly). US-specific evidence was not found; regional policies are noted as such.
overview: PepsiCo is a global food and beverage company (brands include Pepsi, Frito-Lay, Gatorade and Quaker), headquartered in Purchase, New York. Strategy roles are in-house: corporate, sector or brand strategy and transformation teams.
business_type: In-house strategy at a consumer-goods company

employee_support.text: Outside the US, PepsiCo documents generous parental leave (UK and Ireland: 26 weeks at full pay for maternity, 10 weeks for other parents after a year of service; ANZ: 16 weeks for primary carers).
employee_support.significance: Shows company intent, but US terms may differ; ask.

tradeoffs.text: Headquarters is in Purchase, NY (Westchester), which the scanner does not count as New York City.
tradeoffs.significance: Many corporate roles are a commute from NYC; check the posting's office.

unknowns: Early-career strategy or rotational programs in the US.

sources.title: University of York: PepsiCo parenting policies case study (UK)
Women's Agenda: employers extending parental leave (PepsiCo ANZ)
